description: This file defines culture-specific information and functions for date parsing and formatting for Bosnian (Bosnia and Herzegovina) locale, intended for use with the DateJS library.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of the date to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current date to another date.
